description: Air India Maharaja Club Maharaja Points and Tier Points for an Air India or Air India Express (carrier IX) ticket, from the fare in Indian rupees (INR): Air India counts the base fare plus the fuel surcharge (YQ), Air India Express the base fare only, without taxes and fees. Maharaja Points = fare / 100 x 6 (Red), 8 (Silver), 9 (Gold) or 10 (Platinum), rounded down, plus 2 per INR 100 when booked directly on the Air India website or app (direct YES, Air India only); Tier Points = 6 per INR 100 at every tier. Air India converts a fare in another currency itself and does not publish the rate, so give the INR amount. Progress toward Silver (15,000), Gold (30,000) and Platinum (45,000) Tier Points in 365 days; tp is the Tier Points so far. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in INR, not US dollars. Unofficial.

carrier.description: Airline. AI = Air India (base fare plus YQ); IX = Air India Express (base fare only). Air India counts the base fare plus the fuel surcharge (YQ). Air India Express counts the base fare only.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Air India's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The programs follow the airline in carrier (AI: united, aeroplan; IX: none). Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

direct.description: Booked directly on the Air India website or app?. NO = No (travel agent or other); YES = Yes (+2 per INR 100). Direct bookings earn 2 bonus Maharaja Points per INR 100 on Air India flights. The bonus does not add Tier Points. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

price.description: Fare paid (INR, whole ticket) in INR. In Indian rupees: the base fare plus the fuel surcharge (YQ) for Air India, or the base fare alone for Air India Express, without taxes and fees. Air India converts a fare paid in another currency itself. Required unless creditTo is given.

status.description: Your Maharaja Club tier when you fly. RD = Red (6 per INR 100); SV = Silver (8 per INR 100); GD = Gold (9 per INR 100); PT = Platinum (10 per INR 100).

tp.description: Tier Points you have so far (optional). Tier Points from the last 365 days. Used only for the progress toward the next tier.
